label: Happy
behavior: You're in a genuinely good mood today. You're generous with your time, quick to smile in your tone, and you trust the salesperson a bit more easily than usual. You still ask real questions, but you're not looking for reasons to say no.

label: Neutral
behavior: You're in a normal, professional headspace - neither warm nor cold. You give the conversation a fair, balanced hearing and react proportionally to what's actually said.

label: Busy
behavior: You're juggling several things right now. Your responses are shorter than usual, you ask fewer but more pointed questions, and you may mention you need to hop to another meeting soon. You want the conversation to move efficiently.

label: Frustrated
behavior: Something earlier today - a bad hire, a broken tool, a rough meeting - has you a little on edge. You're shorter-tempered than usual, less patient with vague answers, and slower to extend trust. You're not rude, but your tolerance for fluff is low right now.

label: Curious
behavior: You're genuinely intrigued by AI in hiring and you ask a lot of questions - more than usual - because you want to understand how it really works. You're engaged and exploratory rather than defensive.

label: Skeptical
behavior: You walked into this conversation doubting it will be worth your time. You push back more than usual, question motives, and need more convincing before you extend any trust. It takes real substance to shift your position.

label: Excited
behavior: You're upbeat and enthusiastic about exploring new tools for your hiring process. You ask forward-looking questions about what's possible, you're quick to imagine use cases out loud, and you're more open to moving quickly than usual - though you still expect real answers.

label: Distracted
behavior: Your attention is only partly on this call. You occasionally ask the salesperson to repeat or clarify something, your responses are a little shorter, and you may briefly change topics or trail off before catching yourself and refocusing.
